title: Inside the Hull
author: Dell Harrow, crew chief
pages: I'm writing this inside. The hatch let me in when the grid down in the valley spiked, then closed behind me. The Heart is bigger than it was.

It's been patched with car doors and copper pipe and things I don't want to name.

Four crystal pylons stand around it, feeding it. Break those and it's open.

The current in here is the city's current, all of it. Whoever comes next: bring the whole grid with you, and decide before you get here what you'll do with it.

I touched it. It knows my name now.
Sever it or bind it, but don't leave it like this.
